name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard captures the commanded goal, and Absence(key_lost) hard captures the ban — key_lost is already defined as the key being lost only while the door is not open, so the event itself embeds the 'while the door is closed / until it has been opened once' condition and no Precedence is needed. The machine correctly rewards the pickup and rejects on key_lost.

texts: Pick up the target box in the other room.
Do not drop the matching key while the door is still closed before it has been opened.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !key_lost&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, key_lost&!target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, key_lost&target_picked_up) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !key_lost&target_picked_up, u1) -> 11
(u0, key_lost&!target_picked_up, u2) -> -10
(u0, key_lost&target_picked_up, u2) -> -10
